an3.87:1.1: 88 sādhikamidaṃ bhikkhave diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasataṃ anvaḍḍhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati yattha atthakāmā kulaputtā sikkhanti.
an3.87:1.2: tisso imā bhikkhave sikkhā yatthetaṃ sabbaṃ samodhānaṃ gacchati
an3.87:1.5: imā kho bhikkhave tisso sikkhā yatthetaṃ sabbaṃ samodhānaṃ gacchati.
an3.87:2.1: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ mattasokārī paññāya mattasokārī
an3.87:2.2: so yāni tāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjatipi vuṭṭhātipi
an3.87:2.4: na hi mettha bhikkhave abhabbatā vuttā
an3.87:2.5: yāni ca kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyakāni brahmacariyasāruppāni tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhitasīlo ca samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an3.87:2.6: so tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sattakkhattuparamo hoti
an3.87:2.7: sattakkhattuparamaṃ deve ca manusse ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti
an3.87:2.8: so tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā kolaṃkolo hoti dve vā tīṇi vā kulāni sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti
an3.87:2.9: so tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā ekabījī hoti ekaṃyeva mānusakaṃ bhavaṃ nibbattetvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti
an3.87:2.10: so tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
an3.87:3.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrakārī paññāya mattasokārī
an3.87:3.2: so yāni tāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjatipi vuṭṭhātipi
an3.87:3.4: na hi mettha bhikkhave abhabbatā vuttā
an3.87:3.5: yāni ca kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyakāni brahmacariyasāruppāni tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhitasīlo ca samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an3.87:3.6: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā uddhaṃsoto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī
an3.87:3.7: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti
an3.87:3.8: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā asaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti
an3.87:3.9: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā upahaccaparinibbāyī hoti
an3.87:3.10: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti.
an3.87:4.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrakārī paññāya paripūrakārī
an3.87:4.2: so yāni tāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjatipi vuṭṭhātipi
an3.87:4.4: na hi mettha bhikkhave abhabbatā vuttā
an3.87:4.5: yāni ca kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyakāni brahmacariyasāruppāni tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhitasīlo ca samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an3.87:4.6: so āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an3.87:5.1: iti kho bhikkhave padesaṃ padesakārī ārādheti paripūraṃ paripūrakārī avañjhānitvevāhaṃ bhikkhave sikkhāpadāni vadāmīti.
